name: Vulcanair V1.0
summary: Italian four-seat trainer and tourer, derived from the Partenavia P.64 Oscar and built to compete head-on with the Cessna 172.

wings: High wing braced by a strut on each side
engines: Single Lycoming flat-four (180 hp) in a smooth cowl
fuselage: Four-seat cabin with two front doors and a third door on the right rear
Fixed tricycle gear with wheel fairings
tail: Conventional fin and rudder with a low horizontal tail

tellTales: Four-seat strut-braced high-wing with a rectangular, untapered wing
Fixed tricycle gear with wheel fairings
Extra door on the right rear of the cabin

confusedWith.howToTell: The 172 has tapered outer wing panels and only two doors; the V1.0 has a constant-chord rectangular wing and a rear right door.
The 182 has a bigger cowl and a three-blade propeller; the V1.0 has a smaller cowl and a rectangular wing.
The SA160 is a two-seater with a glossy composite body; the V1.0 is a four-seater with a rectangular wing.
